critical.title: Receipt verification memory-drift check is a semantic stub
critical.owasp: A01:2021 Broken Access Control / integrity binding failure
critical.detail: memory_drift_rejected never reads live Docker mem_limit/State; it only compares an in-memory drifted plan to the receipt plan and is always true by construction. Deploy identity integrity gate can report success without proving the running stack matches the memory contract.

high.title: Identity mismatch soft-pass when Serve health fails
high.detail: If serve_health_status !== 200, identity_mismatch_rejected is forced true (default proveIdentityMismatch !== false). Fails to prove fail-closed identity rejection against a live endpoint.

high.title: live_services dimension accepts zero live containers
high.detail: liveServiceCount === 0 is treated as ok, so receipt-driven verify can pass dimensions without binding to running containers.

high.title: Unredacted child-process error leakage
high.detail: runOrFail embeds raw stderr/stdout into thrown Error messages. Docker/Compose failures can echo env-substituted secret values into operator-visible errors, violating the task constraint NEVER log unredacted command errors.

high.title: IMP-AC-14 test theatre / mock private Serve
high.detail: Test injects mock /health and defaults baseUrl to LAN 192.168.1.160, so GREEN does not prove private Tailscale Serve HTTPS 44111 or real identity drift rejection.

medium.title: target_host preflight always passes
medium.detail: setCheck('target_host', true, target) never validates against hostname/MagicDNS Self; mis-targeted deploy hosts can preflight green.

medium.title: Funnel detection is brittle string/regex over JSON
medium.detail: Funnel enablement heuristics may miss alternate status shapes; prefer structured Serve JSON path validation of HTTPS handlers + explicit Funnel object emptiness.

medium.title: countCredentialValueMatches incomplete canary set
medium.detail: Patterns miss HOLO_KEY_*, RESTIC_PASSWORD, R2 keys, base64url random secrets without key labels. Receipt gate is necessary but not sufficient.

medium.title: PrivateServeStatus.raw may retain full Serve status blob
medium.detail: If serialized to evidence, peer/topology metadata could leak beyond non-secret receipt policy.

low.title: LOC budget overrun / missing RED evidence
low.detail: ~1883 insertions vs 300 LOC budget; tdd_mode red_first has no RED capture artifacts under evidence/D08-07/.

positive_controls: deploy:preflight is non-mutating with command ledger; evidence shows zero mutations and real docker/tailscale invocations
applyPrivateTailscaleServe requires authorized; uses tailscale serve --bg --https=N http://127.0.0.1:N; refuses Funnel
assertApprovedSecretFile rejects symlink, non-regular, group/world-writable, out-of-store paths
Unauthorized apply refuses before Docker; runtime secrets under ~/.config/holocron not under evidence/
Receipt construction scans for credential-shaped values; no secrets.yaml values in committed evidence
